title.en: What the Syringe outline cannot add to Integrated Mixer Pump

description.en: Section titles come from Syringe; the Integrated Mixer Pump figures stay the printed ones. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Integrated Mixer Pump. The published table prints Main Motor / Mixer Motor 45 kW / 14 kW; Theoretical Output 21 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Pumping Distance (H / V) 100 m / 300 m; Max. Aggregate Size 4 cm and below; Delivery Pipe Diameter 100 / 125 mm; Dimensions (L×W×H) 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm; Main Unit Weight 4500 kg; Series Note 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 节标题来自《Syringe》，搅拌泵一体机的数字仍是已印数字。邢台河北品锦机械公布搅拌泵一体机。已公布参数表印有：主电机 / 搅拌电机45 kW / 14 kW；理论输送量21 m³/h；最大出口压力23 MPa；料斗容积0.4 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直）100 m / 300 m；最大骨料粒径4 cm and below；输送管内径100 / 125 mm；外形尺寸3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm；整机重量4500 kg；系列说明30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
